phases.name: Phase 1
phases.focus: Establish movement baseline and insulin-compatible exercise habits for fat loss and glycaemic control.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.focus: Increase training stimulus with progressive overload while refining nutrition to support steady glycemic improvements.

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.focus: Optimize conditioning and nutrition strategies for sustainable fat loss and A1c reduction.

non_negotiables: Always consult with client’s clinician if new meds or HbA1c changes.

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Fat-Loss & Glycemic Control Program for Type 2 Diabetes"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary fitness:
    name "Fat loss and improved glycemic control"
  GOAL secondary metabolic:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and A1c stability"
PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Upper/Push" training 45m:
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Lower/Pull" training 45m:
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romainan_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Full-body Conditioning" training 40m:
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
        main straight_sets:
          circuit(4):
            push_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
            air_bike 30s
            step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
            mountain_climber 30s
          rest 120 seconds between rounds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Active Recovery / Mobility" training 30m:
        warmup:
          slow_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility_flow 1x20m
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 5m
  WEEK 2:
    DAY "Upper/Push" training 45m:
      warmup:
        rowing 5m
      main straight_sets:
        dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        lateral_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        shoulder_stretch 2m
        tricep_stretch 2m
  WEEK 2:
    DAY "Lower/Pull" training 45m:
      warmup:
        bike 5m

        squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        good_morning 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

        leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        quad_stretch 2m
        glute_stretch 2m
  WEEK 2:

          dumbbell_swing 30s
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

      cooldown:
